full_sentence: It is widely reported that the company will close two factories next year.
acceptable_variants: the company is going to close two factories next year.
the firm will shut down two factories next year.

options.text: to close two factories next year.
options.why_wrong: After 'that', a finite clause with its own subject and verb is needed; the infinitive does not fit this reporting structure.

options.text: the company will close two factories next year.

options.why_wrong: A gerund cannot follow 'that' here; the structure needs a full clause with a subject and a finite verb.

options.text: will the company close two factories next year?
options.why_wrong: A question form cannot follow 'that' in a reported statement; the word order must be that of a statement.

explanation: In reported statements, 'that' introduces a full clause with its own subject and a finite verb. Turkish speakers may find this unusual, because the reporting verb in their language usually comes at the end of the sentence, so the English order needs deliberate practice.
